rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a method, plan, or person that is not up to the job.

example.english: This method has been tried several times and is still ineffective.
example.traditional: 呢個方法試過幾次都唔掂。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 fong1 faat3 si3 gwo3 gei2 ci3 dou1 m4 dim6

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that something is useless or gives no practical benefit.

example.english: This umbrella leaks, so carrying it is ineffective.
example.traditional: 呢把傘漏水，帶住都冇用。
example.jyutping: ne1 baa2 saan3 lau6 seoi2 daai2 zyu6 dou1 mou5 jung6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person who lacks the ability or competence to do something.

example.english: He cannot even put together such a simple report; he is really ineffective.
example.traditional: 佢連咁簡單嘅報表都整唔掂，真係冇料。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lin4 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 bou3 biu2 dou1 zing2 m4 dim6 zan1 hai6 mou5 liu2
